name: EVE Preview Manager
tagline: Utility for EVE Online multiboxing with real-time previews and hotkeys
blurb: EVE Preview Manager is a lightweight utility designed to enhance the EVE Online multi-boxing experience.
description:
EVE Preview Manager is a lightweight utility designed to enhance the EVE Online multi-boxing
experience.

Key features include:

• Live Previews: Real-time thumbnails of all running clients.

• Rapid Switching: Robust hotkey support to instantly switch focus between clients.

• Customization: Configurable font, borders, colors, size, opacity, and more

• Profiles: Save and load multiple configurations on the fly for different setups

NOTE: This application is not affiliated with CCP Games.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
